translatableContent.value: Skyfade Family Matching Set - Dress & Shirt

• Fabric: Lightweight woven fabric with a soft, floaty drape — built for warm-weather strolls, resort dinners, and seaside photo sessions.
  • Family Story: A four-role matching set — moms and girls in the strappy ombre dress, dads and boys in the matching crewneck tee — so the whole family reads as one coordinated group in every shot.
  • Print: Skyfade — a soft sky-to-white ombre wash, available in Blue or Lavender, with a calm horizon-line gradient that photographs beautifully against open beaches and pale resort walls.
  • Design: Choose Dress for moms and girls — sleeveless spaghetti-strap silhouette with an airy ombre skirt; choose Shirt for dads and boys — a relaxed short-sleeve crewneck tee in the same fade.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach. Cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size Range: Girls & Boys 2–10 Years · Mother S–3XL · Father S–4XL — exact measurements below. Both Blue and Lavender share the same size chart.

Skyfade is the easy way to put the whole family in one calm, vacation-ready palette. The dress option drops a sleeveless spaghetti-strap cami over an airy ombre skirt for moms and girls, while the shirt option keeps it simple for dads and boys with a soft short-sleeve crewneck in the matching fade. Pick Blue for sea-and-sky tones or Lavender for soft sunset light — both colorways are cut from the same gradient and share the same size chart.

Whether you're packing for a beach week, a resort dinner, or a Sunday family portrait, Skyfade reads as one coordinated set in every photo. Mix sizes across roles — add extra pieces for siblings, grandparents, or visiting family — and dress the whole crew in the same horizon-line palette.

Key Features:

  • Four-Role Matching: One ombre fade, two cuts — Dress for moms and girls, Shirt for dads and boys.
  • Two Colorways: Blue or Lavender, both fading softly into white. Same size chart applies to both.
  • Strappy Cami Dress: Sleeveless spaghetti-strap silhouette with a floaty ombre skirt for moms and girls.
  • Crewneck Short-Sleeve Shirt: Relaxed short-sleeve tee with a clean crewneck for dads and boys.
  • Vacation-Ready Palette: Soft sky-to-white gradient that photographs beautifully against beaches and resort whites.

Pick your color, pick each family member's type and size, and slip into Skyfade — for the next sunny weekend, family portrait, or seaside dinner.

translations.value: Skyfade familie matchende sæt - kjole og skjorte

• Stof: Letvægtsvævet stof med en flydende, strandklar afdækning; det nøjagtige fiberindhold var ikke synligt fra den blokerede leverandørside.
  • Familiehistorie: Et familiematchende look med fire roller til mødre, fædre, piger og drenge i koordinerede ombre feriefarver.
  • Farver: Vælg blå eller lavendel, som begge falmer blødt ind i hvidt for en luftig badestemning.
  • Designdetaljer: Piger og mødre bærer den ombre-kjole med stropper; drenge og fædre bærer den matchende kortærmede skjorte med rund hals. Shorts, hatte, smykker, tasker og sandaler er kun styling.
  • Pleje: Maskinvaskes koldt på skånsomt, linjetørt, må ikke bleges, og brug et køligt strygejern med vrangen ud, hvis det er nødvendigt.
  • Størrelsesområde: Barn 2 år til og med barn 9-10 år, mor S-3XL og far S-4XL.
